validation_metric_selection: Maximum mean SI-SDR among checkpoints with STOI >= initial baseline STOI - 0.005; if all fail, retain max SI-SDR with gate-failure flag. No ASR or test selection.
clean_identity_loss: Every fifth optimizer step: 0.1 * waveform mean squared reconstruction error / reference mean square, using clean multichannel training speech only. No additional fivefold interval multiplier.
balanced_sampling: point probability 0.5, point angle uniform over seven training angles; multi8 probability 0.5; ordinary uniform over same fixed pool (point probability 0.25)
extension: Only an optional third paired seed at the same 3000 steps, if the first two pairs and both ablations finish successfully before cutoff with >=30 minutes estimated training margin. No post-test tuning.
evaluation: 360 locked test mixtures, fixed FP32 inference, saved FLOAT WAV metrics, single fixed tiny.en recognizer. Clean-input diagnostic on 30 test sources. No human acoustic-deletion labels assigned automatically.
independent_unit: Source utterance for paired bootstrap; repeated mixtures and seeds are not additional independent speakers.
